lane: D300 capture-order bounded independent plan attack; read-only source/evidence

evidence_checked.class_proof: Prior actual helper injected-lifecycle A/B proves property-order sensitivity; this review inspected source and diagnosis, did not rerun probe.
evidence_checked.original_cause: UNRESOLVED. Original report conflates envelope equality, source presence/value equality, and exceptions. Key reordering reproduces signature but is not proof Chrome reordered the original envelope.

implementation_obligations: Envelope is a record with exactly five own fields schema/sourceKey/owner/payload/seal; compare each strictly to expected original at capture, with seal validation. Shared inspect/restore/verify admission must reject missing, foreign, corrupt, and additional envelope fields consistently. Do not stringify whole envelope for identity.
Strings remain opaque and strictly byte-equal throughout capture/verify, including malformed JSON and whitespace. No parsing strings as Settings objects and no canonicalizing their contents.

For nonstrings admit only finite JSON values: null, booleans, strings, numbers surviving exact roundtrip, dense ordered arrays, and plain own-field records recursively. Explicitly reject unsupported/erased/coerced values, including undefined own values, functions, symbols, nonfinite numbers, sparse arrays, cycles, BigInt and nonplain objects. Reject before backup write when original is invalid; do not let JSON serialization normalize a forbidden input.

Typed recursive equality ignores only record property insertion order. Exact own keysets, unknown fields, scalar values/types, array shape/order/length remain binding. Preserve absence distinctly from present null and present other values.
Keep existing storage operations and readback counts. Compute capture predicates from already-read values; source presence/value drift between reads must still fail before ownership/body.

Diagnostics are optional booleans/null and fixed enum capture substages with explicit unavailable for storage/transport exceptions. Project only known names and permitted value types into the actual WeakMap-branded integrity receipt; never spread evaluation results, Error.details, owner, backup key, payload, raw Settings or digest. Preserve capture diagnosis separately from cleanup inspect outcome.
No changes to application Settings, T10 immutable policy/comparator, deadline, native harness, CI, auth, release, or original evidence. No automatic retry based on source-only green.

A_B_acceptance.external_seam: Chrome local storage backend clones and independently sorts nested object keys at capture write/readback; actual injected expression remains intact and actual T40/T67/T37 runners use it. Backend must preserve raw string bytes and all scalar values.
A_B_acceptance.A_old_RED: Pinned unmodified helper with reorder-only backend fails capture before body with zero fixture reloads and owned retained backup receipt matching original native class. Assert body/click nonentry, not any rejection.
A_B_acceptance.B_new_GREEN: Same backend and same caller/data executes actual control then retires document, restores complete original, reloads, verifies raw string or exact typed JSON semantic original, runs hydrated UI postcondition, and only then disposes owned backup.
A_B_acceptance.guard_forcing: Reintroducing order-sensitive whole-envelope equality must turn reorder-only guard red. Never sort/canonicalize both baseline and actual in assertions; compare raw strings directly and inspect backend operations/preserved original independently.
A_B_acceptance.scope_limit: Source seam is model proof, not original native operand evidence or full live browser acceptance.

negative_guards: capture source changes between initial get and combined readback: sourcePresence or sourceValue false; no ownership/body/source mutation/disposal; backup retained
missing/extra envelope own field and altered schema/sourceKey/owner/payload/seal: fatal; inspection must not brand it owned
same semantic Settings string with whitespace/key-order byte change: unequal; malformed string unchanged roundtrips exactly
nonstring nested record key reorder alone passes; unknown-key addition/removal/value drift fails; scalar type drift fails
array element reorder/length/type changes fail; nested object key reorder inside array alone passes
unsupported non-JSON source representations fail explicitly before backup write, not after silent JSON coercion
absent source stays absent; partial and explicit raw containers preserve unknown siblings; null and supported nonstring container remain distinct
corrupt/foreign/missing backup never restores; wrong post-reload hydrated UI retains backup; delayed source write at late verify still fails
storage reject and evaluate transport reject yield finite unavailable/substage fields, preserve primary failure, and never expose canary strings or arbitrary result keys in published receipt
same actual T40 path leaves immutable T10 footprint exact; existing ownership/restore/reload/disposal mutation guards remain forcing
